# Narvis 0.2.7
This maintenance release keeps the Session Island attached to the MacBook notch when the display layout changes.
- Repositions the resident Island trigger after a display is connected, disconnected, or rearranged. - Retracts an open Island during a display change, then recalculates its placement the next time it opens. - Keeps the signed one-click update flow, the restored Narvis app icon, and the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 bundle unchanged.

# Narvis 0.2.6
This maintenance release restores the Narvis app icon in the signed DMG and installed application. Narvis 0.2.5 could display the generic macOS document icon because the SwiftPM/Xcode release product did not copy `Narvis.icns` into the final app bundle.
- Bundles the dot-matrix Narvis icon in `Narvis.app/Contents/Resources`. - Declares the icon in the final signed app's `Info.plist`. - Restores Sparkle's complete updater runtime in clean source checkouts so the signed one-click updater is present in every reproducible release build. - Keeps the one-click Narvis update flow and the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 bundle unchanged.

# Narvis 0.2.5
This release advances the signed update channel so the one-click updater added in Narvis 0.2.4 can be verified end to end against a real newer version.
- Keeps the one-click download, verification, installation and relaunch flow. - Keeps the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 bundle and atomic managed installation behavior. - Preserves existing global Adapter releases and source checkouts.

# Narvis 0.2.4
- Makes the panel's **Update** button genuinely one-click: that click authorizes the update, and Narvis then downloads, verifies, extracts, installs and relaunches automatically. - Keeps visible progress and error reporting while removing Sparkle's two redundant install confirmation steps. - Informational-only releases still use Sparkle's standard prompt and are never treated as installable application updates.
The update remains protected by the signed GitHub Pages appcast, Sparkle EdDSA, an immutable GitHub Release, Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.

# Narvis 0.2.3
This is the first Narvis release with a one-click, signed update channel.
- Adds an **Update** button to the Narvis panel. Updates are downloaded from an immutable public GitHub Release and verified with Sparkle EdDSA before install. - Bundles the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 release. On a new Mac, Narvis installs it into Application Support and automatically runs the idempotent `init` and `register` steps. - Adapter installations managed by Narvis update atomically with the app. A failed install leaves the previous managed version available for rollback. - Existing global Adapter releases and source checkouts are preserved and keep their existing update paths. - Removes GitHub CLI, Git, repository access and terminal commands from the new user path. Node.js 20 or later remains required.
The DMG is universal (`arm64` + `x86_64`), Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. It records the bundled Adapter commit and checksum for diagnosis.
